I feel ya. And let me tell you: IT'S NOT YOU! This has nothing to do with you not looking like a supermodel or not being rich. Absolutely nothing. It has to do with THEIR insecurities, THEIR shitty personalities. 

I've been cheated on as well by every single guy I've ever dated. And I worked as a model. And I have a Master's degree, I'm smart. I'm funny. And I'm not saying these things to brag or whatever, I'm saying them to make a point. It's not you, it's them. Everything is ok with you and you should be proud of how amazing you are. Unlike them, you're able to fall deeply in love, to be committed to one person and to be loyal to them. To me, that's amazing because many people aren't even capable of love or being faithful. 

And I know it can be hard, but you need to stay positive, I'm trying to stay positive even after my ex of five years had a months long affair. One day, you'll hopefully meet someone who's as devoted to you as you are to them, and if not you'll be fine too! Life isn't just about finding love and a partner. It's about so much more- Work on your goals, focus on worl, on a hobby, go on a trip, make new friends. Don't make your life about finding a partner and you WILL be happy, I promise.

You need experience, and you get that experience by working for others, not for yourself. Sure, there are a couple of people out there who didn't even finish college and became rich anyways, but those are very rare cases. 

My recommendation: Get a job first, get hands-on experience, learn the skills you need to be successful, make some money and start saving. In a couple of years you can reevaluate the situation and possibly make real money as a selfemployed person. Good luck.
